description: Run State Explorer page (dev-only) — displays UI state exploration results captured during verification phases. Users can browse exploration history, view detailed reports of state snapshots, and compare application state at different points in execution.

groups.name: Exploration History Browsing
groups.description: The State Explorer presents a history of past state exploration runs associated with the selected workflow run. Each exploration represents a point-in-time capture of the target application's UI state. Users browse this history to find specific exploration runs, understand the progression of state changes across the workflow, and select individual explorations for detailed review. The history view is the entry point for all state analysis.

assertions.description: The user can see a list of past state exploration runs, each showing when the exploration was performed and its key characteristics, enabling them to find the specific state capture they want to investigate
The user can select an individual exploration run to view its detailed report, transitioning from the history overview to a focused view of that specific state capture
When no run is selected, the user sees a clear message directing them to select a run from the Run Dashboard, preventing confusion about why no explorations are displayed

groups.name: Exploration Report Viewing
groups.description: When the user selects a specific exploration from the history, they see a detailed report of the captured state. This report shows the UI elements that were discovered, their properties and values, and the overall structure of the application at that point in time. The report is the core analytical artifact that helps developers verify whether expected state changes occurred during workflow execution.

assertions.description: When an exploration is selected, the user sees a detailed report showing the captured UI state, including element properties, values, and structural information about the target application at the time of capture
The user can navigate back from a detailed exploration report to the history list, allowing fluid browsing between different exploration snapshots
The user can trigger AI analysis of the exploration results, sending captured state data to AI for interpretation and debugging assistance when manual analysis is insufficient

groups.name: Verification and Debugging Support
groups.description: The State Explorer's primary purpose is to support verification debugging. When a verification phase reports unexpected results, developers use state explorations to understand why the application was in a particular state. By comparing state snapshots taken at different execution points, users can identify what changed (or did not change) and trace the root cause of verification failures back to specific automation actions or AI decisions.

assertions.description: The user can view state information from different points in execution, enabling comparison of before and after states to verify that expected changes occurred during automation

State exploration results provide enough context (element names, values, visibility, enabled state) for the user to diagnose why a verification check passed or failed against the captured application state

states.name: No Run Selected
states.description: No workflow run has been chosen. The page displays guidance prompting the user to select a run from the Run Dashboard before any exploration data can be shown.

transitions.name: User selects a run that has state explorations
User selects a run that has no explorations

states.name: Empty — No Explorations
states.description: A run is selected but it has no state exploration results yet. The page shows a message indicating no explorations are available for this run.

transitions.name: Exploration results arrive for the selected run

states.name: Exploration History Browsing
states.description: The history of past state explorations is displayed for the selected run. Each entry shows when the exploration was performed. The user can select an individual exploration to view its detailed report.

transitions.name: User selects an exploration to view its report

states.name: Exploration Report Viewing
states.description: A detailed exploration report is displayed showing captured UI state including element properties, values, and structural information. The user can navigate back to the history list or trigger AI analysis of the results.

transitions.name: User clicks Back to return to exploration history
